Instead, the Planner incorrectly included these cousins in the count of children (adding 3 to the total kids count), which inflated the potato requirement. By miscounting the attendees and ignoring the dietary restriction, the Planner derived an incorrect base for the calculation, leading the subsequent agents to produce the wrong answer (5 bags instead of the correct 2).
